svg.text: Boss protrusion above the flange face
Boss perpendicularity to the flange face
Overall length, boss end to spigot end
Drive socket in the boss end
1. INTERPRET PER ASME Y14.5-2018. UNITS mm. UNLESS NOTED: X.X ±0.2, X.XX ±0.05.
2. BREAK ALL EDGES 0.2-0.4 UNLESS NOTED. NO BURRS.
3. VENT ALL BLIND HOLES IN VACUUM-EXPOSED PARTS PER DR-6 (spec/00).
4. PROVENANCE: EVERY DIMENSION TRACES PER THE SIDECAR PROVENANCE FILE OF THIS DRAWING (AIEF).
5. THE LOCATOR IS THE FASTENER — NO SEPARATE SCREW (ECR-D-009). TORQUE 1.2 N·m.
6. GRIND BOSS AND FLANGE (POSITIONAL BUDGET); CONCENTRICITY 0.010 TIR (AP-D09).
7. ANTI-GALLING DRY FILM ON FLANGE OD AND SPIGOT THREADS; PASSIVATE.
8. BOSS SHORTER THAN SLOT DEPTH BY DESIGN — DO NOT 'MATCH' TO 3.0 (spec/06 §5 WARNING).
